ValidationRule.description: Healthcare Partner / GPO field is required when the Opportunity's Account is in the Healthcare Industry Gitlab #16066 #26453: Added Metadata Activation Custom setting as bypass logic
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
IF( AND(
NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity'))),
ISPICKVAL(Group_Purchasing_Organization_GPO__c,""), OR(ISPICKVAL(Account.IM_Industry__c,"Healthcare"),ISPICKVAL(Account.IM_Industry__c,"Hospitals"),ISPICKVAL(Account.IM_Industry__c,"Outpatient Care & Physician Groups"),ISPICKVAL(Account.IM_Industry__c,"Residential Care, Rehabilitation, and Homes")), OR (RecordType.DeveloperName ='Standard_Opportunity',RecordType.DeveloperName='CPQ_Sales_Opportunity'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, '1 - Qualification')), NOT(ISNEW()), NOT($Setup.OpportunityAttribution__c.BypassValidation__c), Billing_Country__r.Name = "United States",NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) ),true,false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a Healthcare Partner / GPO value
